summary: strip_curtain / food processing strip curtain: wrong_scale

findings.description: The caption states 9 leaves of 0.300 x 2.980 x 0.002 m in strip_curtain and a total of 3.3 kg. The stated area density is 2.5 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 20 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 9. Every leaf is 9x too light.
findings.where: caption; the leaves in panels 1 and 2
